Commentary.Commentary: The players are back out in the middle. Andre Fletcher and Chris Gayle are the openers for West Indies. Mitchell Starc has the new ball. Fletcher to face. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right. The hosts will look to seal the series here, as they come out to chase an under-par target of 142. It is manageable but in the shortest format of the game, you can't say anything. The chase gets underway in a while. Stay tuned!

The West Indians were great with the ball even tonight and exceptionally good in the field. They started slowly, as Wade was on the counter-attack. But McCoy broke the opening stand to get things started for the Men In Maroon. Again, it was the spinning pair of Fabian Allen and Hayden Walsh who got things back under control. The duo had combined figures of 8-0-44-3 stifling the Aussies in the middle overs. Towards the end, Dwayne Bravo bowled superbly. Strangely, Obed McCoy was given just 1 over in the entire inning. Was it just because the others were doing well or is there some injury concern? West Indies will hope not.

MOISES HENRIQUES is up for a chat. Henriques says that West Indies executed their plans really well and it looks a good wicket. Adds that they (Australia) have been guilty of batting in the middle order poorly. Adds that they need to be wary of West Indies' batting order. Tells that they are 20 runs short but if they bowl well, they can defend this score.

Australia got off to a really good start with the help of Finch and Wade. But then came the struggle Australia continue to live with - their failure to command in the middle overs. From 41/0, they slipped to 80/4 in the span of 42 balls. The shot selection was better as compared to the previous two games as one understands that they wanted to avert a collapse but they were still going nowhere. Eventually, the experience of veterans in the domestic circuit, Moises Henriques and Ashton Turner, helped their side to get past 140, with a 59-run stand for the 5th wicket. But again, the visitors failed to make use of the momentum and couldn't quite finish things off.

Wow. How has this innings ended? 15 from the 17th over which was bowled by Dre Russ. 17 in the next 3! This is some solid comeback by the West Indies and they will be very happy with it. The track is a bit slow but 160 would have been a minimum and the Aussies were on track to get there but...

OUT! RUN OUT! Excellent last over from Bravo and West Indies will be very happy with the effort. Yorker on off, Turner plays it back to the bowler. Bravo does well to collect and Christian has taken off. Turner is nowhere to be seen and Bravo runs him out. AUSTRALIA END ON 141 FOR 6.
Bravo sees Christian making room and follows him. Bowls it on a length and Christian pulls it to deep square leg for just a single.
Full toss on the pads, Turner plays it to the deep square leg region for a single.
Who walks out next? It is the veteran Dan Christian.

OUT! CAUGHT AT DEEP MID-WICKET! Fabian Allen does not drop many and he makes it look easy again. Low full toss on middle, Henriques looks to go over deep mid-wicket but does not get the distance on it. Allen at deep mid-wicket takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: Low full toss on the pads, Turner clips it to fine leg for a single.
Full on the pads, Henriques looks to flick but it goes off the pads to the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Who will bowl the final over? It is going to be Dwayne Bravo. His figures 2-0-14-0 so far.
Full on middle, Moises heaves it to long on. Russell comes charging ahead to collect but misfields, concedes three in the end.
Very full outside off, Henriques fails to dig it out as it goes to the keeper.
WIDE! Cottrell bowls another one outside the tramline. Henriques shoulders arms. Wide given.
Full on off, Turner drives it to long off for a single.
Shortish ball around off, Turner moves across and looks to paddle but misses.
Good length ball outside off, Henriques slashes it to short third man where the fielder makes a good stop. A single taken.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length ball outside off, Henriques looks to cut but misses.
WIDE! Way outside off, Henriques lets it to go. Wided.
Sheldon Cottrell comes back into the attack now. His figures 3-0-25-0 so far.
Short ball on middle, Turner pulls it to deep mid-wicket and takes a couple before the fielder cuts it off.
Floated on middle, Henriques plays it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.

A missed stumping! This should have been effected. How costly will this be? Floated ball outside off, Henriques dances down the track and looks to cut but misses. Pooran fails to collect the ball cleanly and Henriques survives.
Flatter ball outside off, Turner pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Henriques heaves it to the leg side for one.
Floated on the pads, Turner sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Hayden Walsh comes back into the attack now. His figures 3-0-12-2 so far.
SIX! Hammered! Short ball on off, Henriques pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie. Australia are on the charge.
Good length ball on off, Henriques pushes it to cover and takes off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses and ends up conceding an overthrow.

Good length ball outside off, Henriques punches it to the deep point region and takes off for a couple. The fielder throws it to the keeper. Pooran throws it at the bowler's end and hits but no damage done.
Full and wide outside off, Henriques looks to drive but misses. Wide not given. That definitely looked a wide.
Low full toss outside off, Turner drives it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! How well has Turner played that? Russell goes full and way outside off, Turner moves that way and then paddles it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Andre Russell comes back into the attack now. His figures 2-0-14-0 so far.
SIX! Boy, how much Australia needed this? Bravo opts for the slower one on middle, Henriques waits for it and then powers it over the bowler's head for a maximum. First one of the game.
Full on off, Ashton drives it to long off for a single.
Slower ball on middle, Henriques pulls it to deep mid-wicket and crosses over.
Slower ball on the pads, Turner works it to deep square leg for one.
Full on middle, Moises drives it to long on for one.
Slower ball outside off, Henriques pushes it to point for a dot.
A length ball, on off. Turner punches it through point for a couple. Moves to 10.
WIDE! A length ball, outside off, swinging away. Turner leaves it alone. Wide called.
A length ball, on middle and leg. Turner moves across and pulls it towards square leg. Chris Gayle is the man to recover the ball who also gets the cheer from the crowd. Two taken.
A length ball, outside off. Turner moves across and defends it to point.
A full length ball, outside off. Moises Henriques cuts it through the point region for a run.
A length ball, on off. Turner pushes it to cover and takes off for a single.
Good length ball, outside off. Ashton Turner leaves it alone.
Sheldon Cottrell comes into the attack. 2-0-18-0 are his figures so far.
A single to end the over. Full and on off. Turner hits it back to the bowler but to his left. Walsh dives to his left to make the stop but instead palms it to mid off. The batters take a run.
Floated on off, Turner pushes it to point.
On off, Turner drives it to cover.

FOUR! Lucky boundary. Floated, on off. turns away a bit. Ashton Turner looks to punch it off the back foot bit it goes off the outside edge and to the right of Chris Gayle at slips. The ball races towards third man fence and finds it.
Looped up, on off. Ashton Turner goes back and defends it solidly.
Full and wide outside off. Moises Henriques uses his feet and pushes it through covers for a single.
Floated, on middle. Moises Henriques is happy to tuck it to the leg side again for a single.
Full and on middle. Moises Henriques flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple. Good running.
Looped up, on off. Moises Henriques pushes it to the off side.
On middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
Full and on middle. Moises Henriques goes back and nudges it to square leg for a couple.
Floated and on off. Moises Henriques goes back and pushes it to cover.
Full and outside off. Moises Henriques works it to the right of point and gets a single.
Who comes out next? It is going to be Ashton Turner.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a catch and what teamwork! This is excellent and look at them, they are over the moon. Excellent fielding and West Indies are on top now. Walsh bowls a flighted ball on middle, Finch looks to smoke it over long on but does not time it well. It goes towards long on. Bravo comes across from long while Allen comes running from deep mid-wicket. It seems that they will collide but Bravo goes for it. He fails to hold on in his first attempt, tries again but it pops out again but Allen is aware of the situation. He keeps his eyes on the ball and dives forward to take an excellent catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter on off, Moises punches it to cover for one.
Loopy ball on off, Henriques defends it to cover.
On middle, worked to the leg side.
Moises Henriques comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hayden Walsh can't keep himself away from the wickets. He is some form in this tour. Alex Carey has to walk back early. Does the middle over struggle continue for Australia? They would hope not. Flighted full and on off. Alex Carey is tempted and goes to play the off drive and does so but uppishly. Lendl Simmons takes a brilliant catch at extra cover.
Commentary.Howout: c Lendl Simmons b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on off. Finch hangs back and pushes it to cover but straight to the fielder.
Full and on leg, Carey nudges it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Flatter and outside off. Finch cuts it towards point for a single.
On middle, Carey works it to the leg side for a single.
Floated on off. Carey defends it out.
FOUR! Placed well by Alex Carey. Looped up, on middle. Carey moves away to the leg side and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Carey nudges it to the leg side for one.
Shortish on the pads, Finch looks to pull but it goes off the bottom half towards short fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Smacked! Floated on middle, Finch flays it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Good fielding in the deep! Short ball on the pads, Finch pulls it to deep square leg. Hayden Walsh runs across and stops it with a dive. Two taken.
On middle, played back to the bowler.
Flighted on the pads, Carey looks to play the reverse but it goes off the gloves to the leg side. A single taken.
Chris Gayle with the ball now. The spin continues. Replacing Hayden Walsh.
Flighted on middle, Finch defends it back to the bowler.
On off, pushed to the off side for one.
FOUR! Confident start from Alex Carey! Gets off the mark on the first ball. Full on middle, Carey goes on his knees and then reverse sweeps it to deep point for a boundary.
Who will come out at number 4? It is going to be Alex Carey.

OUT! LBW! Allen strikes and he sends the man-in-form for Australia, Mitchell Marsh back to the hut for a cheap score. Allen bowls a full one on middle, Marsh walks across and looks to sweep but misses it completely. West Indies appeal confidently and the finger goes up. Marsh does not bother reviewing and goes back. No fireworks from him tonight.
Flatter outside off, Finch cuts it to deep point for one.
Floated outside off, Marsh lifts it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter on off, Finch looks to play it on the off side but gets an inside edge and it goes to the leg side.
On middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for one.
PLAY AND A MISS! Much better from Walsh! Flatter ball outside off, Marsh looks to cut but misses.
Flatter on the pads, Aaron clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Another short ball on middle, pulled to deep square leg for one.
Good fielding in the deep! Short ball on middle, Finch pulls it to deep square leg. The fielder in the deep does well to stop it.
Hayden Walsh comes into the attack now. So, spin from both ends now. He replaces Dwayne Bravo.
FOUR! Good end to the over! 50 up for Australia. Floated outside off, Marsh drives it through extra cover for a boundary.
Quicker ball on the pads, Marsh looks to punch it but gets hit on the pads.
Shortish outside off, Aaron plays it to the off side for another single.
Loopy ball outside off, Marsh drives it to deep cover for a single.
On middle, punched back to the bowler.
Flatter ball outside off, Finch pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Fabian Allen comes into the attack now. He replaces Obed McCoy.
Full outside off, Finch pushes it wide of mid off for a single. Australia are 45 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay.
Short on middle, Marsh pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Shortish on middle and leg, Marsh looks to pull but gets hit on the thigh pad.
On off, pushed to cover.

WIDE! NOT OUT! No spike on Ultra Edge and West Indies lose a review. Full down the leg side, Marsh looks to flick but seems to have missed it. Pooran collects and appeals for a caught behind but the umpire says no. Pooran takes the review. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there is no bat on it. Wided.
Nicholas Pooran takes the review for caught behind. The onfield decision is Not Out. The Ultra Edge shows there is no bat involved. The decision stands. West Indies lose a review here.
Slower ball on middle, Finch clips it to mid-wicket and takes off for a quick single. The fielder throws it to the keeper but it is wide and Mitchell Marsh makes it in the end.
Good length ball on middle, Finch takes a few strides forward and then works it to mid-wicket.
Mitchell Marsh is the next man in. Dwayne Bravo comes into the attack.

OUT! TIMBER! Obed McCoy comes into the side and draws the first blood. A good knock by Matthew Wade comes to an end. Serves a full length ball, on off. Matthew Wade moves away to the leg side, making some room for himself. He looks to push it out but misses it completely. The ball goes onto disturb the off stump. Obed McCoy is delighted.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Wade leaves it. Wide called.
Slower this time. Keeps it full and on off. Finch looks defend but gets an inside edge. The ball rolls to fine leg. Finch takes off for a single.
FOUR! CRACKED! On a length, outside off. Aaron Finch hangs back and cuts it through short third man for a boundary.
A full length ball, on middle and leg. Wade uses his feet and looks to heave it away. He only gets an inside edge, as the ball rolls out to the leg side. The batters take a single.
A full length ball, on off. Finch works it towards point for another single.
A length ball, on off. Wade pushes it to the off side for a run.
Obed McCoy is into the attack.

NOT OUT! A length ball, on off. Wade pushes it to cover and takes off for a single. Chris Gayle collects the ball in the field and has a shy at the non-striker's end. He hits the stumps. The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays roll in and show that Matthew Wade's bat was well inside the crease.
Full and outside off again. Matthew Wade looks to whack it away but misses.
The third umpire is being called for a run out. Matthew Wade is in and his bat is grounded.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off. Matthew Wade leaves it alone. Wide called.
A full length ball, on off. Finch works it to mid-wicket off the inner half of his blade and gets a single.
A length ball, on middle. Finch stays back and flicks it towards square leg for a couple. Fabian Allen does well in the deep.
WIDE! Short ball, down the leg side. Finch looks to pull it away but misses. Wide called.
On a length, on off. Finch keeps it out.
A length ball, on off. Aaron Finch pushes it to mid on.

A length ball, on off. Aaron Finch looks to pull it away, but only manages to get an inside edge. The ball rolls to the off side. The batters take a quick single. Sheldon Cottrell goes to recover the ball and pushes Matthew Wade in the process. Cottrell immediately apologizes after that.
A length ball, on off. Aaron Finch works it to Hayden Walsh at point.
Good length ball, outside off. Aaron Finch looks to cut it away but misses.
A good length ball, on off. Aaron Finch uses his feet and tucks it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
A length ball, on off. Wade pushes it to cover and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Matthew Wade continues to be positive He looks in good touch. A full length ball, on off. Matthew Wade punches it through covers for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Matthew Wade cuts it through point for a single. Moves to 15.
Back of a length ball, outside off. Matthew Wade hangs back and looks to push it out but misses. The ball bounces over the blade.
FOUR! Nicely played. A length ball, on off. Matthew Wade pulls it through square leg for a boundary. Andre Fletcher moves slower to his left and cannot make the stop.
A length ball, on off. Aaron Finch stays back and pushes it through the cover region for another single.
Good length ball, on off. Matthew Wade pulls it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
A length ball, on off. Aaron Finch pushes it through point for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? Andre Russell it is.
A back of a length ball, on off. Finch flicks it out for a single.

In the air...Safe! A touch short, on the bodyline. Matthew Wade is cramped up for room. He looks to pull but manages to get a top edge. The ball flies to the right of the keeper but goes above him. It lands in a vacant area. The batters sneak a single.
EDGY FOUR! A good length ball, on off. Matthew Wade looks to pull it away but does not middle it. He gets an inside edge. The ball scoots past the stumps towards fine leg for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. Matthew Wade pushes it to cover.
Keeps it straight this time. Keeps it full and on off. Matthew Wade defends it to the off side solidly.
FOUR! Gets off the mark on the first ball itself, Matthew Wade. Full length ball, outside off. Matthew Wade creams it through the covers for a boundary. Positive start for Australia.

We are all set to begin! The West Indies' players make their way out to the middle, followed by Aaron Finch and Matthew Wade. The players take a knee in support of the 'Black Lives Matter' movement.  Sheldon Cottrell will start with the ball.

Pitch report - Samuel Badree says that this is a new wicket and it is going to be a very good wicket. Curtly Ambrose says that there is no grass and it looks like that it will be a high-scoring game. Badree tells that the bowlers bowled a much straighter line in the earlier games and that will be the plan here.

Hayden Walsh is there for a chat. He says that it feels good and relieved to be playing again for West Indies and it is a great feeling. Goes onto say that he has been observing the previous series and Shamsi bowled slower and he is trying to get the right pace. Tells that he will try to make the batters hit into the wind and use the surface and try to extract as much spin as possible. Adds that he and Allen are very close.

Nicholas Pooran says that this looks like a good wicket. Informs that they have made one change as McCoy comes back in for Edwards. Tells that they want to see passion from the team and it will be an interesting clash.

Aaron Finch, the Australian skipper, says that they will bat first. Adds that they did not chase too well in the first two games. Goes onto say that this looks like a good pitch and it will play good for 40 overs. Informs that they have made three changes as Meredith, Turner and Carey come in for Agar, McDermott and Philippe.

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Matthew Wade (WK), Mitchell Marsh, Moises Henriques, Alex Carey (IN PLACE OF BEN MCDERMOTT), Ashton Turner (IN PLACE OF JOSH PHILIPPE), Dan Christian, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Riley Meredith (IN PLACE OF ASHTON AGAR), Josh Hazlewood.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Lendl Simmons, Andre Fletcher, Chris Gayle, Shimron Hetmyer, Nicholas Pooran (WK/C), Andre Russell, Dwayne Bravo, Fabian Allen, Hayden Walsh, Sheldon Cottrell, Obed McCoy (IN PLACE OF FIDEL EDWARDS).
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Australia. They have elected to bat first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third T20I between West Indies and Australia. Any guesses who are the favourites to win this game? West Indies right? They have been sensational in this series and have a chance to win the series here itself. They have a pretty good chance of doing that as the form of Australia has been poor. Apart from Mitchell Marsh, no batter has been able to stay out in the middle. The bowling has blown hot and cold with Starc being the major disappointment. Will there be a change in fortunes for Australia or will the hosts continue their good form? We will find out as the toss is not too far away.
